cards.title: Pause Polling for Furbulous App Use

cards.content:
## Instructions

### Why values were Unknown
This dashboard must use your HA entity IDs (area + box name). Wrong prefixes show as Unknown.

### Pause polling
**Pause** / **Pause 1 hr** when polling; **Resume** only when paused.

### Litter / Bag ages
Unknown until first **Refilled litter** or bag-replace event is recorded in HA.

### Bag status
Bag OK · Bag full · No Bag (bit 128 after seal — remove bag so cleans can run).

### Notifications
`mobile_notifications.yaml` is **automations**, not a dashboard. Use Companion `notify.mobile_app_*` or persistent notifications.
